problem: The midpoint validation combines four FILTER NOT EXISTS clauses with AND, so the constraint reports a violation only when all four required midpoint values are absent. A ship with one, two, or three missing required midpoints can therefore pass, despite having exactly four cases.
required_change: Change the query to fail when any one of the four required midpoint positions is missing, for example by combining the four missing-midpoint tests with OR or by using four separate validation constraints.
regression_guard: Preserve exactly four calculation cases and require midpoint calculation data at one-eighth, three-eighths, five-eighths, and seven-eighths of bowLength individually.
